category_title: Individuals with SIB masking social functions under standard assessment conditions
minimal_context: The student is in a padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves while the tutor presents an instructional task using a three-step prompting procedure.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to work. Please sort these blocks into the bin.

STUDENT: (Sits in the padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves, looking away from the instructional stimuli.)

TUTOR: Watch me do it. Pick up the block and put it in the bin like this.

STUDENT: (Ignores the blocks and begins hitting his arms against his legs at a high rate despite the canvas sleeves.)

TUTOR: Let me help you. I am going to guide your hands to put the block in the bin.

STUDENT: (Immediately begins hitting himself in the head, kicking his legs against his torso, and attempting to dig his nails into his skin.)

options.A: Provide a picture schedule of instructional tasks that the student can choose from during the session.
options.B: Implement a specific termination stage counting down the final three to five instructional sessions of the program.
options.C: Increase the duration of the instructional sessions in the padded treatment room from 15 minutes to 30 minutes.
options.D: Implement augmenting tactics, such as response promotion and disruption, and reallocation of responding to options associated with contingent reinforcement.
